clause: Monochrome/tonal-map adjustments (Black&White, Channel Mixer, Gradient Map, Desaturate, Invert, Posterize, Threshold) [STU-RAS-035]

scope.summary: Implement the monochrome/conversion StudioAdjustment kinds over the framework (MT-054): Black & White (per-hue luminance-weight mono conversion + optional tint), Channel Mixer (weighted source-to-output channel mix + constant offset + monochrome), Gradient Map (maps tonal values onto a StudioGradient with dither + reverse), Desaturate (removes color in place), Invert (negative), Posterize (flat tonal levels per channel), and Threshold (high-contrast black/white around a level).
acceptance_criteria: All 7 mono/conversion adjustment kinds as non-destructive layers
Per-hue weighting, gradient mapping, posterize/threshold proven
proof_targets: Black&White + Gradient-Map + Threshold adjustment runtime + snapshot
expected_tests: live: Black & White per-hue weights + tint; Gradient Map maps tone to a gradient; Threshold produces high-contrast B/W — each a re-editable adjustment layer
test: Channel Mixer monochrome + offset proven
acceptance_criteria_original: all 7 mono/conversion adjustment kinds as non-destructive layers + apply-in-place
per-hue weighting, gradient mapping, posterize/threshold proven

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: **[STU-RAS-035]** `StudioAdjustment` is the single canonical adjustment primitive; every adjustment kind MUST be usable both as a non-destructive `adjustment`-kind layer (with built-in mask, clip-to-parent option, and re-editable parameters) and as an explicit destructive apply-in-place command. Presets and one-click adjustment creation MUST be supported.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.
